Delete an uploaded file

```rust title="Rust"
use liter_llm::FileClient;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let file_id = r#"file-abc123"#;
    let client = liter_llm::create_client(std::env::var("API_KEY").expect("API_KEY must be set"), None, None, None, None).unwrap();
    let result = client.delete_file(file_id).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.id);
    println!("{:?}", result.deleted);
}
```
